name: odubo-studio-waf-rules
description: Comprehensive WAF rules for Odubo Studio - Enterprise Security

rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "'" or http.request.uri.query contains "--" or http.request.uri.query contains "/*" or http.request.uri.query contains "*/" or http.request.uri.query contains "xp_" or http.request.uri.query contains "sp_" or http.request.uri.query contains "@@" or http.request.uri.query contains "char(" or http.request.uri.query contains "nchar(" or http.request.uri.query contains "varchar(" or http.request.uri.query contains "nvarchar(" or http.request.uri.query contains "alter" or http.request.uri.query contains "begin" or http.request.uri.query contains "cast" or http.request.uri.query contains "create" or http.request.uri.query contains "cursor" or http.request.uri.query contains "declare" or http.request.uri.query contains "delete" or http.request.uri.query contains "drop" or http.request.uri.query contains "exec" or http.request.uri.query contains "execute" or http.request.uri.query contains "fetch" or http.request.uri.query contains "insert" or http.request.uri.query contains "kill" or http.request.uri.query contains "select" or http.request.uri.query contains "sys" or http.request.uri.query contains "sysobjects" or http.request.uri.query contains "syscolumns" or http.request.uri.query contains "table" or http.request.uri.query contains "update")

(http.request.uri.query contains "<script" or http.request.uri.query contains "javascript:" or http.request.uri.query contains "vbscript:" or http.request.uri.query contains "onload=" or http.request.uri.query contains "onerror=" or http.request.uri.query contains "onclick=" or http.request.uri.query contains "onmouseover=" or http.request.uri.query contains "<iframe" or http.request.uri.query contains "<object" or http.request.uri.query contains "<embed" or http.request.uri.query contains "<form" or http.request.uri.query contains "<input" or http.request.uri.query contains "<textarea" or http.request.uri.query contains "<select" or http.request.uri.query contains "<button" or http.request.uri.query contains "<link" or http.request.uri.query contains "<meta" or http.request.uri.query contains "<style" or http.request.uri.query contains "<title" or http.request.uri.query contains "<base" or http.request.uri.query contains "<bgsound" or http.request.uri.query contains "<link" or http.request.uri.query contains "<meta" or http.request.uri.query contains "<style" or http.request.uri.query contains "<title" or http.request.uri.query contains "<base" or http.request.uri.query contains "<bgsound")

(http.request.uri.path contains "../" or http.request.uri.path contains "..\" or http.request.uri.path contains "./" or http.request.uri.path contains ".\" or http.request.uri.path contains "%2e%2e%2f" or http.request.uri.path contains "%2e%2e%5c" or http.request.uri.path contains "%2e%2e%2f" or http.request.uri.path contains "%2e%2e%5c")

(http.request.uri.query contains "|" or http.request.uri.query contains ";" or http.request.uri.query contains "&" or http.request.uri.query contains "&&" or http.request.uri.query contains "||" or http.request.uri.query contains "`" or http.request.uri.query contains "$(" or http.request.uri.query contains "${" or http.request.uri.query contains "%3b" or http.request.uri.query contains "%7c" or http.request.uri.query contains "%26" or http.request.uri.query contains "%60" or http.request.uri.query contains "%24%28" or http.request.uri.query contains "%24%7b")

(http.request.uri.query contains "file://" or http.request.uri.query contains "php://" or http.request.uri.query contains "data://" or http.request.uri.query contains "expect://" or http.request.uri.query contains "input://" or http.request.uri.query contains "filter://" or http.request.uri.query contains "zip://" or http.request.uri.query contains "phar://" or http.request.uri.query contains "glob://" or http.request.uri.query contains "rar://" or http.request.uri.query contains "ogg://" or http.request.uri.query contains "audio://" or http.request.uri.query contains "video://" or http.request.uri.query contains "image://" or http.request.uri.query contains "text://" or http.request.uri.query contains "http://" or http.request.uri.query contains "https://" or http.request.uri.query contains "ftp://" or http.request.uri.query contains "ftps://" or http.request.uri.query contains "sftp://" or http.request.uri.query contains "ssh2://" or http.request.uri.query contains "ssh2.shell://" or http.request.uri.query contains "ssh2.exec://" or http.request.uri.query contains "ssh2.tunnel://" or http.request.uri.query contains "ssh2.sftp://" or http.request.uri.query contains "ssh2.scp://" or http.request.uri.query contains "ssh2.shell://" or http.request.uri.query contains "ssh2.exec://" or http.request.uri.query contains "ssh2.tunnel://" or http.request.uri.query contains "ssh2.sftp://" or http.request.uri.query contains "ssh2.scp://")

rules.description: Enforce rate limiting for API endpoints
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/api/" and (http.request.uri.path contains "/users" or http.request.uri.path contains "/videos" or http.request.uri.path contains "/likes" or http.request.uri.path contains "/albums" or http.request.uri.path contains "/tracks"))

(http.user_agent contains "bot" or http.user_agent contains "crawler" or http.user_agent contains "spider" or http.user_agent contains "scraper" or http.user_agent contains "curl" or http.user_agent contains "wget" or http.user_agent contains "python" or http.user_agent contains "java" or http.user_agent contains "perl" or http.user_agent contains "ruby" or http.user_agent contains "php" or http.user_agent contains "go" or http.user_agent contains "node" or http.user_agent contains "dotnet" or http.user_agent contains "powershell" or http.user_agent contains "bash" or http.user_agent contains "sh" or http.user_agent contains "zsh" or http.user_agent contains "fish" or http.user_agent contains "tcsh" or http.user_agent contains "ksh" or http.user_agent contains "dash" or http.user_agent contains "busybox" or http.user_agent contains "wget" or http.user_agent contains "curl" or http.user_agent contains "lynx" or http.user_agent contains "links" or http.user_agent contains "elinks" or http.user_agent contains "w3m" or http.user_agent contains "links2" or http.user_agent contains "elinks" or http.user_agent contains "w3m" or http.user_agent contains "links2")
(http.request.uri.path contains "/admin" or http.request.uri.path contains "/studio" or http.request.uri.path contains "/api/admin")

(http.request.uri.path contains ".env" or http.request.uri.path contains ".git" or http.request.uri.path contains ".svn" or http.request.uri.path contains ".htaccess" or http.request.uri.path contains "wp-config.php" or http.request.uri.path contains "config.php" or http.request.uri.path contains "database.yml" or http.request.uri.path contains "web.config" or http.request.uri.path contains "robots.txt" or http.request.uri.path contains "sitemap.xml" or http.request.uri.path contains ".well-known" or http.request.uri.path contains "crossdomain.xml" or http.request.uri.path contains "clientaccesspolicy.xml" or http.request.uri.path contains "favicon.ico" or http.request.uri.path contains "apple-touch-icon.png" or http.request.uri.path contains "android-chrome-192x192.png" or http.request.uri.path contains "android-chrome-512x512.png" or http.request.uri.path contains "mstile-150x150.png" or http.request.uri.path contains "safari-pinned-tab.svg" or http.request.uri.path contains "browserconfig.xml" or http.request.uri.path contains "manifest.json" or http.request.uri.path contains "service-worker.js" or http.request.uri.path contains "sw.js" or http.request.uri.path contains "worker.js" or http.request.uri.path contains "sw.js.map" or http.request.uri.path contains "worker.js.map" or http.request.uri.path contains "sw.js.map" or http.request.uri.path contains "worker.js.map")

rules.description: Restrict HTTP methods for sensitive endpoints
rules.expression: (http.request.method eq "DELETE" or http.request.method eq "PUT" or http.request.method eq "PATCH") and (http.request.uri.path contains "/api/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/admin" or http.request.uri.path contains "/studio")

rules.description: Validate content types for file uploads
rules.expression: (http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path contains "/api/" and http.request.uri.path contains "/upload") and not (http.request.headers["content-type"] contains "multipart/form-data" or http.request.headers["content-type"] contains "application/json" or http.request.headers["content-type"] contains "text/plain")
